content.title: AN ORGAN-BY-ORGAN CHEAT SHEET FOR YOUR PLATE
facts: **Beets... wait, no** — **artichokes** kickstart bile flow, helping your **LIVER** break down fat instead of storing it.
**Buckwheat** is loaded with rutin, which strengthens vein walls and helps your **CIRCULATION** push blood back up from your legs.
**Brazil nuts** – just 2/day give you enough selenium to help your **THYROID** convert hormones properly.
**Asparagus** acts as a natural diuretic, easing the load on your **KIDNEYS** by helping flush excess sodium.
**Turkey breast** is rich in tryptophan, which your **BRAIN** converts into serotonin for a calmer mood.
**Collard greens** – 1 cup cooked delivers a big dose of vitamin K, guiding calcium straight into your **BONES** instead of your arteries.
**Mussels** pack B12 and iron together, giving your **NERVOUS SYSTEM** the raw material it needs to insulate nerve fibers.
**Pomegranate seeds** contain punicalagins that relax blood vessels, easing pressure on your **HEART**.
**Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.
content.caption:
Let's break down a few of these: **artichokes** contain cynarin, a compound that specifically stimulates bile production in the liver, which is what your body uses to emulsify and clear dietary fat — that's why they're often used as a traditional after-meal digestive. **Buckwheat** isn't a grain at all, it's a seed, and the rutin inside it doesn't just support veins, it also has a mild anti-inflammatory effect that can ease that heavy-legs feeling after a long day standing. And **Brazil nuts** are so selenium-dense that just two a day can meet your full daily need — more than that and you're not getting extra benefit, just extra risk, so portion really matters here. Everyone's body is different, listen to yours.
